page.layout: One column of text, centred on the page; title block at top; a catchword-like signature "Altius" with "(?)(?)" at the foot right; no margin notes.

main_text.head: Celsissimo & Illustrissimo Principi, Dn. Dn. FREDERICO GVILIELMO, Marchioni Brandeburgico, Electoratus Imperialis, &c. Ducatus Prussiæ, Juliacensis, Clivensis, Montium, &c. Hæredi.
Super Historia Clivensi, Ipsius Celsitudini nuncupata.
main_text.p: MAgne juventutis Princeps, cui destinat uni Post Patrem fasces Clivia læta suos.
Illa armis opibusque potens, atque ubere gleba Dives, & omnigeno flore superba virûm. Unam quam Rhenus pleno Pater irrigat alveo, Non alibi placidus non tumidusve magis.
Hoc tantum infelix Regio, primordia gentis, Historiæ ignoret quod rudis ipsa, suæ. Quodq; diu trepidet turbantibus undiq; bellis, Dum Mars vicino fervidus orbe furit.

Te Duce nunc alius rerum promittitur ordo, Et novus Historiæ te Duce surgit honos. Quæ prælustre tuum jam præfert pagina nomen, Non dubias infert in loca cæca faces, Non vetus hic canitur vulgati fabula cygni, Quam nimium simplex plebs celebravit avem.

page.notes: The initial M is a large woodcut letter. Ornamented initial and italic headings reproduced as best read. Passage lines in the verse are set as printed; a few letters in the verse are uncertain (e.g. "prælustre", "Quæ") and may be misread. The "(?)(?)" marks at the foot are doubtful.
